record: AI-use plan: data classification and tool routing
description: Per planned deliverable: the data-sensitivity class and where any AI assistance may run. Participant-level, unblinded or identifiable data: a local, version-pinned model with no data leaving the validated environment. De-identified text and specifications: a contracted cloud service under a data-processing agreement, never a consumer account. Reported numbers: validated programs and engines only.
standard: 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail; ALCOA++; ICH E6(R3) data integrity
